message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r7d -- no tap through a soft keyboard: the sign-in keyboard put away on the PC list, taps only at the video view's centre with no keyboard up

verify-0164 S run oa-s-20261030025800-36232 (548d199): 1-3 PASS, 4 FAIL events=0 -- 3_window_first_frame.png shows the
sign-in keyboard (inputType 0x81) still covering the lower 2/3 of the viewer; the fixed 1200,540 went into it
(logcat TouchInteractionService). menu()'s and P-5d's wake taps had the same coordinate.

oa_avd.py:
- ime_state(): `dumpsys input_method` -- mInputShown / mWindowVisible / mDecorViewVisible / mIsInputViewShown true =
  shown; mInputShown false and none true = hidden; anything else = unknown (not safe).
- hide_ime_on_hosts() (S, after sign-in, before the PC card): BACK only while the keyboard is shown, on the PC list --
  there BACK reaching the app would only open the exit question (b554e76 MainActivity.kt handleSystemBack: HOSTS ->
  showExitConfirmDialog), which is checked; in the viewer it would leave the viewer (handleViewerBack), so BACK is
  never sent there. Judged: keyboard hidden after, the PC still listed, no dialog. Unknown state: FAIL, no key.
- viewer_tap_point(): the centre of videoTextureView (b554e76 activity_main.xml) from the UI dump, only with the
  keyboard hidden; else no tap. 4: no safe point -> FAIL with NO tap. menu() / P-5d: no wake tap then.
- no fixed 1200,540 left. Gates, OFF, job, slot, adb: unchanged. No device run.

oa_pick_test.py 28/28 (stubs/fake_ui_adb: the keyboard state, the PC list, the video view, BACK taken by the
keyboard or leaking to the app): new -- 4 with a keyboard up / unreadable / no video view: FAIL, 0 taps on the
picture; the one tap at the video view centre (540,1268) PASS; menu with a keyboard up: no wake tap, no key; 1b:
BACK hides it (PASS), BACK leaking to the app (exit question) FAIL, unreadable FAIL with no key, none up: nothing
sent. Regressions: oa_pmclear_test 12/12, oa_adb_redact_test 7/7, oa_orchestration_test 22/22.

The run's disconnect (17:59:59 NOT_CONNECTED, host reason=none 10 s after its last control message) is investigated
apart: .claude/caplife/oa_s_disconnect_investigation_r1.md (not changed by this commit).
